name: immortal
description: an Immortal, an elite warrior in ornate gold armour: a full gold helmet with a T-shaped visor slit and a tall flowing red crest, gold pauldrons, a gold scale breastplate over black mail, a red tabard hanging from a gold belt with a red gem, gold greaves and sabatons, a long red cape, a large oval gold shield with a red sun emblem on his RIGHT arm, and a curved steel scimitar with a gold hilt raised in his LEFT hand
hands: the scimitar stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and the oval sun shield on his right arm on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the scimitar is lifted up over the helmet with its curved tip pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the scimitar cocked behind the head with the curved blade hanging down behind the shoulders, the oval sun shield tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the curved scimitar blade is level, pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: scimitar arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the curved blade slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, shield arm swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the scimitar carries on down until its curved tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the red helmet crest and the red cape trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the scimitar lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the helmeted head snaps back toward the upper-left, the red crest whipping, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the oval sun shield flung out to the left, scimitar arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the scimitar dipping, the oval sun shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, scimitar arm flung up, the oval sun shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the helmeted head droops, the scimitar lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the scimitar's curved tip resting on the ground, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the scimitar slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the red cape flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the gold helmet on and the red cape spread under him; the scimitar lies on the ground at the lower-right; the oval sun shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the oval shield rocks, the red crest settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the gold helmet on, the scimitar and the oval sun shield on the ground beside him
